method.margin_definition: min_x s(x)D(x) / ((|a|^2+|b|^2) * max_x ||v(x)||^2); max||v||^2 = 3 for all six encodings
method.class_margin: max over tried members; median over realized classes; class realized if margin > threshold (stage A only)
method.members: feasible members of the class, output-complement duplicates removed, fixed-seed random order, first n_members = stage A; stage B = further members in rounds, only for classes still unrealized, up to stage_b_cap per class and stage_b_wall_s per variant, reported separately; unitary_rows candidates must also pass the tr M = 0 LP (necessary condition)
method.optimizer: logsumexp smooth min, L-BFGS-B over betas, rank by non-smooth margin, top n_polish refined by SLSQP epigraph, final value always from actual_margin(a,b)

variants.unitary_rows: a†, b† are two rows of a 3x3 unitary (task statement); 3-MZI Reck triangle ports (0,1),(1,2),(0,1), T(theta,phi) as in ptf2_check
variants.free_ab: a, b in C^3 unconstrained (literal page method text)

revisions.when: after 3-class pilot, before the full run
revisions.change: unitary_rows candidate members filtered by an extra LP with tr M = 0; stage B changed to rounds with a wall limit; mzi() rewritten in closed form
revisions.reason: pilot showed all 3 phase-encoding classes failing under unitary_rows: tr M = 0 removes the constant term of D, so most LP-feasible members are provably impossible and random picks were wasted. tr M = 0 is a necessary condition, so this changes which members are tried, not the definition. Threshold, member count, start count and normalization unchanged.
